SELECT `id`, `w`, `matched_id` FROM (SELECT `__asof_primary`.`experiment_id` AS `experiment_id`, `__asof_primary`.`id` AS `id`, `__asof_primary`.`timestamp` AS `timestamp`, `__asof_primary`.`date` AS `date`, `__asof_primary`.`device_name` AS `device_name`, `__asof_primary`.`latitude` AS `latitude`, `__asof_primary`.`n` AS `n`, `__asof_primary`.`v` AS `v`, CASE WHEN `__asof_latest`.at >= `__asof_time` - INTERVAL '60' MINUTE THEN `__asof_latest`.data.`w` END AS `w`, CASE WHEN `__asof_latest`.at >= `__asof_time` - INTERVAL '60' MINUTE THEN `__asof_latest`.data.`id` END AS `matched_id`
FROM (
  SELECT *, LAST_VALUE(`__asof_secondary`, true) OVER (
    PARTITION BY `__asof_key`
    ORDER BY `__asof_time`, `__asof_kind`, `__asof_tie` DESC NULLS LAST
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS `__asof_latest`
  FROM (
    SELECT p.`device_name` AS `__asof_key`, p.`timestamp` AS `__asof_time`,
      1 AS `__asof_kind`, NULL AS `__asof_tie`,
      named_struct('experiment_id', p.`experiment_id`, 'id', p.`id`, 'timestamp', p.`timestamp`, 'date', p.`date`, 'device_name', p.`device_name`, 'latitude', p.`latitude`, 'n', p.`n`, 'v', p.`v`) AS `__asof_primary`, NULL AS `__asof_secondary`
    FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT (`macro_output`), try_variant_get(`macro_output`, '$["n"]', 'BIGINT') AS `n`, try_variant_get(`macro_output`, '$["v"]', 'DOUBLE') AS `v`
FROM chart_rows
WHERE `experiment_id` = 'charts') p
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.`device_name` AS `__asof_key`, s.`timestamp` AS `__asof_time`,
      0 AS `__asof_kind`, s.`id` AS `__asof_tie`,
      NULL AS `__asof_primary`,
      named_struct('at', s.`timestamp`, 'data', named_struct('w', s.`w`, 'id', s.`id`)) AS `__asof_secondary`
    FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT (`macro_output`), try_variant_get(`macro_output`, '$["w"]', 'DOUBLE') AS `w`
FROM chart_matches
WHERE `experiment_id` = 'charts') s

) carried
WHERE `__asof_kind` = 1) joined_data ORDER BY `id` ASC LIMIT 100001

FROM chart_rows
WHERE `experiment_id` = 'nanOrders') GROUP BY `device_name` ORDER BY `device_name` ASC LIMIT 100001
latestAndEarliestByNaN:
SELECT `device_name` AS `device_name`, MAX_BY(`id`, CASE WHEN `v` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE struct(`v`, `id`) END) AS `id_latest`, MIN_BY(`id`, `v`) AS `id_earliest` FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT (`macro_output`), try_variant_get(`macro_output`, '$["n"]', 'BIGINT') AS `n`, try_variant_get(`macro_output`, '$["v"]', 'DOUBLE') AS `v`
FROM chart_rows
WHERE `experiment_id` = 'nanOrders') GROUP BY `device_name` ORDER BY `device_name` ASC LIMIT 100001
rawSeriesByAnswer:
SELECT `id`, try_variant_get(`questions_data`, '$["plot"]', 'STRING') AS `plot`, try_variant_get(`questions_data`, '$["reading"]', 'DOUBLE') AS `reading`, try_variant_get(`custom_metadata`, '$["area"]', 'DECIMAL(10,2)') AS `area`, try_variant_get(`custom_metadata`, '$["soil"]', 'STRING') AS `soil`
FROM chart_raw_rows
WHERE `experiment_id` = 'charts'
ORDER BY `reading` DESC
LIMIT 4
rawAnswerStats:
SELECT `plot` AS `plot`, AVG(`reading`) AS `reading_avg`, SUM(`reading`) AS `reading_sum`, COUNT(*) AS `count_count` FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT (`questions_data`, `custom_metadata`), try_variant_get(`questions_data`, '$["plot"]', 'STRING') AS `plot`, try_variant_get(`questions_data`, '$["reading"]', 'DOUBLE') AS `reading`, try_variant_get(`custom_metadata`, '$["area"]', 'DECIMAL(10,2)') AS `area`, try_variant_get(`custom_metadata`, '$["soil"]', 'STRING') AS `soil`
FROM chart_raw_rows
WHERE `experiment_id` = 'charts') GROUP BY `plot` ORDER BY `plot` ASC LIMIT 100001
metadataDecimalBuckets:
SELECT FLOOR((`area` - 0) / 5) AS `area_bucket`, SUM(`area`) AS `area_sum`, AVG(`area`) AS `area_avg`, COUNT(*) AS `count_count` FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT (`questions_data`, `custom_metadata`), try_variant_get(`questions_data`, '$["plot"]', 'STRING') AS `plot`, try_variant_get(`questions_data`, '$["reading"]', 'DOUBLE') AS `reading`, try_variant_get(`custom_metadata`, '$["area"]', 'DECIMAL(10,2)') AS `area`, try_variant_get(`custom_metadata`, '$["soil"]', 'STRING') AS `soil`
FROM chart_raw_rows
WHERE `experiment_id` = 'charts') GROUP BY FLOOR((`area` - 0) / 5) ORDER BY `area_bucket` ASC LIMIT 100001

uploadSeries:
SELECT `id`, try_variant_get(`uploaded_data`, '$["ph"]', 'DOUBLE') AS `ph`, try_variant_get(`uploaded_data`, '$["plot"]', 'STRING') AS `plot`
FROM chart_uploads
WHERE `experiment_id` = 'charts'
ORDER BY `uploaded_at` ASC
LIMIT 100001
uploadAverages:
SELECT `plot` AS `plot`, AVG(`ph`) AS `ph_avg`, COUNT(*) AS `count_count` FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT (`uploaded_data`), try_variant_get(`uploaded_data`, '$["ph"]', 'DOUBLE') AS `ph`, try_variant_get(`uploaded_data`, '$["plot"]', 'STRING') AS `plot`
FROM chart_uploads
WHERE `experiment_id` = 'charts') GROUP BY `plot` ORDER BY `plot` ASC LIMIT 100001
